findings.description: T44f (Task 44 design P3-1 B): the Findings not in the findings of any page (the Findings of the Run rules, such as the cross-page rules; some have a page ID). The Findings of a page are in pages[].findings only. All the Findings of the Run are the page Findings (in the page order) followed by these. The version stays 1.0; documents of the earlier writers have all the Findings here.
